verdict.rationale: Highnote's own Secure Inputs SDK lets cardholders set and update their PIN from the developer's UI via iframes, so the PIN part of the story is self-serve without support tickets. Nothing in the evidence covers 3DS enrollment or a server-side PIN reset API. Missing for 10: 3DS enrollment for online use, explicit PIN reset flow and direct API mutation documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets

citations.quote: The Highnote Secure Inputs SDK enables customers to securely set and update their PIN from your UI using iframes.
